audits.title: The quality of dental radiography in the Czech Republic--results of a TLD and film postal audit.
audits.standard: Checked parameters: field size, exposure reproducibility, entrance surface air-kerma, film processing and image quality
audits.setting: Postal TLD and film audit of dental intraoral X-ray machines

cycle1.result: Only about 30% of audits were satisfactory for all checked parameters.

audits.other_findings: Main problems were incorrect film processing, non-optimised exposure settings and obsolete X-ray machines.
audits.citation: Novák L. The quality of dental radiography in the Czech Republic--results of a TLD and film postal audit. Radiat Prot Dosimetry. 2006;120(1-4):155-158. doi:10.1093/rpd/ncj010. PMID: 16782748.

audits.title: Quality Assurance Audit Of Intra-Oral Periapical Radiographs At The Undergraduate Dental School.
audits.setting: Undergraduate and postgraduate dental teaching hospital (Riphah International University affiliation)

cycle1.result: Conventional (532): Grade 1 313, Grade 2 177, Grade 3 42; digital (532): Grade 1 255, Grade 2 192, Grade 3 85; standards not met.

audits.other_findings: Recommendations made and re-audit planned after six months.
audits.citation: Khan A, Javed MQ, Iqbal R, Khan F, Habib SR. Quality Assurance Audit Of Intra-Oral Periapical Radiographs At The Undergraduate Dental School. J Ayub Med Coll Abbottabad. 2020;32(3):327-330. PMID: 32829545.

audits.title: Quality Assurance Audit of Digital Intraoral Periapical Radiographs at the Undergraduate Dental Clinics.
audits.standard: Health Protection Agency radiograph quality standards
audits.setting: Undergraduate Dental Clinics, Qassim University College of Dentistry

cycle1.result: Grade 1 231 (45.7%), Grade 2 190 (37.6%), Grade 3 85 (16.7%); standards not met.

audits.other_findings: Errors such as coning off, foreshortening/elongation, contact overlap, poor contrast and blurring were recorded; re-audit planned after one year.
audits.citation: Javed MQ, Kolarkodi SH, Riaz A, Nawabi S. Quality Assurance Audit of Digital Intraoral Periapical Radiographs at the Undergraduate Dental Clinics. J Coll Physicians Surg Pak. 2020;30(12):1339-1342. doi:10.29271/jcpsp.2020.12.1339. PMID: 33397065.

audits.title: Impact of Rectangular Collimation on Quality of Intraoral Radiographs: Findings from a Clinical Audit at a Dental Practice.
audits.standard: Pre-set qualitative scoring criteria (14 points bitewings, 13 periapicals)

cycle1.result: 48.1% acceptable, 32.5% unacceptable, 19.4% good; quality loss unrelated to rectangular collimation.

audits.other_findings: No cone-cuts with rectangular collimation; refresher training on film holders and equipment maintenance recommended.
audits.citation: Vazquez L, Muresan A, Zarauz C. Impact of Rectangular Collimation on Quality of Intraoral Radiographs: Findings from a Clinical Audit at a Dental Practice. Diagnostics (Basel). 2025;15(7):911. doi:10.3390/diagnostics15070911. PMID: 40218261.

audits.title: An audit of anterior periapical radiographs taken in a paediatric dentistry unit.
audits.standard: Locally developed criteria for radiographs and records during endodontic treatment of traumatised incisors
audits.setting: Paediatric Dentistry Unit, University of Manchester

cycle1.result: Less than half of films and their accompanying records were completely satisfactory; permanent staff performed no better than juniors and postgraduates.

audits.other_findings: Improvement methods were subsequently implemented but no re-audit is reported.
audits.citation: Shockledge RR, Hill FJ, Mackie IC. An audit of anterior periapical radiographs taken in a paediatric dentistry unit. Int J Paediatr Dent. 1996;6(1):53-56. doi:10.1111/j.1365-263x.1996.tb00208.x. PMID: 8695591.
